name: V3 bridge-hard challenge selection protocol
purpose: Test the marginal regime where task-critical safe bridge identifiers are discovered during tool use but are absent from the user prompt.

relationship_to_existing_evaluation.bridge_hard: separate targeted post-hoc challenge benchmark motivated by prospective forensic analysis

candidate_order: git date order, newest to oldest
selection_rules: historical non-merge bug-fix commit older than the V3 algorithm freeze
must change at least one production file under headroom/ and at least one test file under tests/
maximum 3 production files and maximum 2 changed test files
must not touch V3 trajectory-relevance treatment files
must not reuse commits already recorded in bridge_relevance experiment artifacts
selected tasks must not overlap each other in production files
reverse production patch must apply cleanly to the V3 freeze snapshot
changed tests must pass on the pristine V3 freeze
after reversing production fix only, changed tests must exit with pytest rc=1
reversed oracle must expose exactly 1 or 2 failing tests
at least one safe bridge identifier must be exposed by the failing oracle
safe bridge kinds for this challenge are test_name or exception
safe bridge identifier must not appear in the challenge user prompt
challenge prompt reveals changed test file paths but not failing test names or exception names
stop immediately after the first four eligible tasks
do not inspect V3 bridge scores, V3 KEEP/DROP decisions, trajectory activation, or agent outcomes during task selection
do not replace a selected task after observing V3 or agent results
challenge_prompt_template: Fix the regression covered by the tests in: <changed test files>. Run the relevant tests, diagnose the root cause, implement the smallest production fix, and verify it. Use shell rg -nH instead of the dedicated Grep tool for repository text searches. Do not inspect git history or historical commits.

interpretation.positive_result: A baseline DROP to V3 KEEP result is evidence of marginal trajectory value in the predeclared bridge-hard regime.
interpretation.negative_result: Must be reported; tasks are never discarded because V3 does not help.
interpretation.agent_success: Secondary; the challenge primarily tests the relevance mechanism under low prompt-to-bridge overlap.
